summary: Centralized rsyslog TLS logging is configured and verified across node1–node4.
actions_performed: Installed rsyslog TLS support on all nodes and generated a private CA/server certificate on node4.
Configured local0-only TCP/TLS forwarding with persistent queues from node1–node3.
Configured node4 TLS-only listener on port 6514 with source-identifiable central logs.
Configured 14-day daily compressed log rotation and persistent firewall/service settings.
Verified TLS delivery, user-facility exclusion, rotation, syntax, and service health.
